summary: Every party is a ticket: a date and start-time stub torn from the details by a perforated edge, set in Sofia Sans (a Bulgarian-made typeface) on warm paper with grape ink.

world.name: Ticket booth
world.summary: Warm paper, grape-black ink and one strong outline instead of shadows. Tall condensed numerals make times and dates scannable; the only solid red on any screen is a missing deposit.
world.signature: The ticket stub: each party's date tile and start time sit on a stub, separated from the details by a dashed perforation with two round notches cut into the card edge.
rules: Do put a party's date and start time on its ticket stub, in the condensed display face / Don't bury times in body text.
Do outline cards with one 1.5px ink line / Don't add drop shadows.
Do fill a tag solid only for a missing deposit / Don't fill warnings or confirmations solid.
Do show unknown money as the dashed 'не е зададено' mark / Don't write 0 or invent a figure.
